features.feature: A call is transcribed on the computer as it goes, the transcript ready seconds after it ends; a failure falls back to a full pass, and a failed one shows Failed with `transcribe.error`
Each sentence keeps the language it was spoken in, only among the allowed languages (Ukrainian and Russian apart); a language pinned for a call applies to it alone
Silence gives no made-up text; on speakers the others aren't duplicated as Me
Remote voices become Speaker N or the names Teams lights; one other person names the whole remote track
A transcription server (another Echo or OpenAI-compatible) takes the utterances; when it is down this computer's model takes over
A long call transcribes and the computer stays usable
